title: Palak Paneer (Spinach with Cottage Cheese)
description: Palak Paneer is an iconic North Indian dish featuring soft paneer cubes simmered in a creamy, vibrant spinach sauce. Fresh spinach, aromatic spices, and a touch of cream or yogurt create a comforting and flavorful curry.

ingredients.title: For the Paneer
items: Paneer (Indian cottage cheese) – 250 g, cut into cubes
Ghee or oil – 1 tsp (optional, for lightly sautéing)

ingredients.title: For the Spinach Gravy
items: Fresh spinach leaves – 500 g, washed and chopped

ingredients.title: For Finishing
items: Fresh cream – 2 tbsp or yogurt – 2 tbsp (optional, for richness)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Blanching the Spinach
steps: Bring water to a boil in a large pan and add a pinch of salt.
Add the spinach leaves and blanch for 2 minutes.
Drain the spinach and immediately transfer it to ice-cold water to preserve its vibrant green color.
Blend the spinach into a smooth puree using a little water.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Preparing the Masala
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add chopped onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add ginger, garlic, and green chilies. Sauté for 1–2 minutes.
Add tomatoes, turmeric powder, red chili powder, and salt. Cook until the tomatoes soften and the oil begins to separate.
Let the mixture cool slightly, then blend into a smooth paste for a silkier texture, if desired.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Cooking the Palak Gravy
steps: Combine the spinach puree and onion-tomato paste in a pan.
Simmer for 5–7 minutes over low heat.
Add garam masala and adjust the salt to taste.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Adding the Paneer
steps: Lightly sauté the paneer cubes in ghee or oil for about 1 minute to keep them soft, if desired.
Add the paneer cubes to the spinach gravy and cook for 2–3 minutes.
Stir in fresh cream or yogurt for added richness.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Finishing Touches
steps: Check the seasoning and add a few drops of lemon juice to balance the flavors.
Garnish with a small dollop of butter or cream.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with roti or naan.
Pair with jeera rice for a flavorful rice-based meal.

chefTips: Blanch the spinach briefly and transfer it immediately to ice-cold water to retain its bright green color.
Avoid overcooking the spinach gravy to preserve its fresh flavor and vibrant color.
For a silky-smooth restaurant-style texture, blend the cooked onion-tomato masala before combining it with the spinach puree.
Use soft, fresh paneer and avoid overcooking it so the cubes remain tender.
Add lemon juice at the end to balance the richness of the gravy.
